About us

Bitget Wallet is the non-custodial crypto wallet designed to make crypto simple and secure for everyone. With over 80 million users, we bring together a full suite of crypto services, including swaps, market insights, staking, rewards, DApp exploration, and payment solutions. Supporting 130+ blockchains and millions of tokens, Bitget Wallet enables seamless multi-chain trading across hundreds of DEXs and cross-chain bridges. Backed by a $300+ million user protection fund, it ensures the highest level of security for users' assets.

Responsibilities

• Trend-Driven Campaigns: Track on-chain narratives daily across memecoins, new chains, launchpads, and RWA, as well as macro events such as FOMC meetings and earnings reports. Help assess and tier trends, and quickly turn them into executable campaigns.
• Platform-Level Campaigns: Own the planning and execution of holiday campaigns (Thanksgiving, Black Friday, Christmas, year-end, etc.) and recurring campaigns. Monitor competitor activity and quickly develop campaign strategies in response.
• Campaign Planning & Budgeting: Independently define campaign objectives, core metrics, mechanics (trading competitions, leaderboards, rebates, holding rewards, points, etc.), budgets, timelines, and anti-abuse risk controls. Plan ahead for converting and retaining users after the campaign ends. Before launch, ensure the end-to-end trading flow runs smoothly, including regional availability, campaign entry points, product functionality, and liquidity.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Distribution: Coordinate with product and engineering, design, content, operations, risk control, customer support, and other teams to drive efficient campaign delivery. Partner with the in-app traffic and regional teams to build comprehensive distribution plans (channel × timing × creative × link). These plans cover in-app placements, push notifications, social media, community groups, KOLs, and seeding campaigns.
• Post-Campaign Analysis & Playbooks: Focus on quality metrics such as qualified traders and new-user retention, rather than trading volume alone. Use data analysis to evaluate campaign ROI and user quality, continuously build reusable campaign templates, and feed optimization requests back to the product team.

Requirements

• 2–4 years of experience in campaign operations, user growth, or marketing, including at least 1 year in the crypto industry; familiar with exchanges, wallets, DEXs, trading bots, or other on-chain trading products.
• Hands-on, end-to-end experience in campaign planning and execution; able to present 2–3 independently owned campaign case studies. Each should cover the full cycle, from strategy and budgeting to execution and post-campaign review, with supporting budget and performance data.
• Meticulous and detail-oriented, with strong execution skills and a high sense of ownership; able to stay on top of details at every stage to ensure smooth campaign launches.
• Strong ROI mindset and data analysis skills; able to model budgets before launch and evaluate actual performance through post-campaign data reviews.
• Passionate about memes and on-chain trading, with first-hand trading experience; closely follows market narratives and community discussions on Crypto Twitter (X), Telegram, and other channels.
• Comfortable with the fast pace of the crypto market; able to respond to trends the same day and execute quickly, and available to work weekends when needed.
• Strong cross-functional communication and resource coordination skills, with the ability to drive projects forward; fluent in Mandarin Chinese, with professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience designing campaign mechanics such as trading competitions, leaderboards, points programs, and rebates; familiar with anti-abuse and anti-Sybil safeguards.
• Hands-on experience planning and running campaigns across multiple regional markets, such as Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America.

Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers.

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do

• Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.

• Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.

• Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.

• Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.

• Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are

• 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.

• You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.

• Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.

• Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.

• Nice to haves:

• hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch

• knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

Your mission

Millions of customers trust Bitpanda to protect their money, identities and digital assets. As a Senior SOC Analyst, you'll play a critical role in staying ahead of evolving threats by building the capabilities that detect attacks, respond to incidents and continuously strengthen our security posture.

You'll combine deep technical expertise with engineering excellence to evolve our security operations, drive automation at scale and partner across the business to embed security into everything we build. Your work will directly shape how Bitpanda protects its customers today; and how it stays resilient tomorrow.

What you'll do

• Detection engineering. Own the strategy and quality of our detection library in Elastic Security (ES|QL/KQL), designing high-fidelity detections mapped to real-world attacker techniques while continuously improving coverage, reducing noise and raising the maturity of our SOC.

• Drive incident response and threat hunting. Lead investigations into complex security incidents, proactively hunt for advanced threats across AWS, Elastic and Datadog, refine response playbooks, and turn every incident into lasting improvements to our security capabilities.

• Build automation that scales security. Design and implement automated investigation, enrichment and response workflows using SOAR, APIs and custom tooling, reducing manual effort while increasing speed, consistency and resilience across security operations.

• Strengthen Bitpanda's security posture. Improve cloud security monitoring, system hardening and security tooling across our AWS environment, partner with engineering teams to proactively eliminate risk, and support compliance initiatives including ISO 27001, PCI DSS and DORA.

• Raise the security bar across the organisation. Act as a technical leader within the Security team, mentor engineers, influence architectural decisions, champion security best practices and help build a security-first culture across Bitpanda.

• Keep millions of users safe, no matter the time of day. As part of this commitment, you'll participate in a weekly rotating on-call schedule alongside the rest of the team.

Who you are:

• You have 4+ years of hands-on security engineering experience, with deep expertise across incident response, threat hunting, SIEM, digital forensics and scripting.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly analytical and driven Strategy Associate / Senior Associate to join our team. At Crypto.com, our #1 core value is "Think Clearly." We are looking for individuals who can not only design exceptional strategies but critically evaluate them, identifying nuances that others might miss.
If you are looking to step away from traditional corporate strategy or consulting constraints—where months are spent drafting 100-page presentations for endless committee reviews—and want to make a real, immediate impact, this role is for you.


What to Expect
•

Impact Over Output: Say goodbye to endless PowerPoint decks. We value getting your point across in the clearest way possible—quality over quantity and length. We make decisions fast and expect fast results.

•

Beyond AI-Level Work: We expect you to contribute original ideas and points of view (POVs) that AI cannot generate.

•

A Flat & Fast-Paced Environment: You will work in a highly dynamic setting without unnecessary bureaucracy.

•

Broad Fintech Exposure: You won't just look at crypto and blockchain. You will gain hands-on experience across a wide range of cutting-edge topics, including predictions trading, securities and derivatives trading, payments, and more.

•

Perks & Growth: We offer flexible Work-From-Home (WFH) arrangements and fast-track promotion opportunities for top performers.

What You’ll Do
•

Hit the Ground Running: Dive straight into high-impact projects, moving at the speed of the crypto and fintech markets, such as:

•

Pricing Analysis & Recommendations: Going beyond basic competitor benchmarking to design strategic fee structures and monetization models for new or existing products;

•

CLV Optimization: Ideate high-impact campaigns designed to maximize Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), delivering actionable proposals that optimize user acquisition, deepen engagement, and drive long-term retention;

•

Strategic Investment or Partnership Evaluation: Critically evaluate potential investment or partnership targets across the broader fintech landscape, and deliver a clear, original Point of View (POV) to guide strategic decisions.

•

Think Clearly & Critically: Develop innovative strategic initiatives while critically evaluating existing strategies to pressure-test assumptions and uncover blind spots.

•

Focus on What Matters: Apply the 80/20 rule to complex business problems. Cut through the noise, get straight to the crux of the issue, and simplify solutions in an elegant, actionable way.

•

Drive Fast Results: Translate strategic thinking into immediate business actions, leveraging clear and concise communication to align stakeholders and drive execution.

What We Look For
•

Experience: 1 to 3 years of full-time work experience

•

Background: Relevant experience in fintech and/or strategy. Experience in top-tier strategy consulting is highly preferred.

•

Track Record of Excellence: Candidates with above-average ratings in past performance reviews will be strongly prioritized.

•

Original Critical Thinkers: You possess a high degree of original thought, business acumen, and the ability to synthesize complex information better and faster than AI.

•

Curiosity Over Prior Knowledge: No prior knowledge of crypto, tokenized assets, or predictions is required (though it is a plus!). We hire for curiosity, foundational intelligence, and a genuine interest in the space first.

Life @ Crypto.com
 
Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.
Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.
Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.
Work Culture. Our colleagues are some of the best in the industry; we are all here to help and support one another.
One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet. 
 
 
Are you ready to kickstart your future with us? 
 
Benefits
 
Competitive salary 
Medical insurance package with extended coverage to dependents 
Attractive annual leave entitlement including: birthday, work anniversary
Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid or remote set-up
Aspire career alternatives through us. Our internal mobility program can offer employees a diverse scope.  
Work Perks: crypto.com visa card provided upon joining 
 
Our Crypto.com benefits packages vary depending on region requirements, you can learn more from our talent acquisition team.
 
About Crypto.com:
 
Founded in 2016, Crypto.com serves more than 150 million customers and is the world's fastest growing global cryptocurrency platform. Our vision is simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™. Built on a foundation of security, privacy, and compliance, Crypto.com is committed to accelerating the adoption of cryptocurrency through innovation and empowering the next generation of builders, creators, and entrepreneurs to develop a fairer and more equitable digital ecosystem.
 
Learn more at https://crypto.com. 
 
Crypto.com is an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating an environment where opportunities are presented to everyone in a fair and transparent way. Crypto.com values diversity and inclusion, seeking candidates with a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills that complement and strengthen our team.
 
Personal data provided by applicants will be used for recruitment purposes only.

Who We Are
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm 220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.
Your Role in Our Mission
As the Lead, you’ll own the vision, direction, and delivery of the entire People technology ecosystem at NEXT Ventures. You’ll set the strategy for how People systems, platforms, and data serve the business and guide the team that builds and runs them.
Your scope covers everything from core HR platform operations and data governance to custom-built internal platforms, OKR and performance management systems, AI-powered automation, and people analytics. You’ll define what gets built, how it’s architected, and in what order then direct the team to deliver it.
Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer, you’ll be the single point of ownership for People technology: translating business and HR strategy into a technology roadmap, making build-vs-buy decisions, setting engineering and data standards, and ensuring every system your team ships moves the organisation forward.
This role is about direction and ownership, not solo execution. You set the course, define the standards, remove the blockers, and hold the bar. But you need to be technically fluent enough to make sharp calls on architecture, data, and AI you can’t guide what you can’t evaluate.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Strategic Direction & Roadmap Ownership
•
Define and own the People Technology roadmap spanning platform operations, custom system development, OKR management, performance systems, AI/agentic automation, and people analytics.
•
Set the technical vision and architectural direction for the function; ensure every system decision aligns with where the business is headed.
•
Make build-vs-buy and vendor decisions; advise the CPO on technology investment, platform strategy, and long-term architecture.
•
Identify and eliminate technical debt, duplication, and fragmentation across the portfolio proactively.
Process Ownership & Governance
•
Own and continuously improve the processes that keep People systems reliable, accurate, and compliant - data governance, system administration standards, change management, and release practices.
•
Establish and enforce standards for data integrity, privacy, and security across all People platforms and operating jurisdictions.
•
Define how requirements flow from business stakeholders into the team’s backlog: intake, scoping, prioritisation, and delivery cadence.
•
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of People technology from ideation and requirements through architecture, build, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Platform & Systems Oversight
•
Direct the administration, configuration, and evolution of the core HR tech stack ensuring platform availability, data accuracy, and a seamless experience for HR and end users.
•
Guide the development and scaling of custom-built internal platforms, including the proprietary HR portal and associated tools.
•
Oversee the OKR platform (company, department, team, and individual OKR management) and the Performance platform (grading, metrics, PIP/PSP workflows), ensuring both evolve with organisational needs.
•
Direct the automation of HR lifecycle workflows onboarding, offboarding, probation, leave, approvals across systems.
AI, Agentic Systems & Innovation
•
Set the direction for AI and agentic automation across the function deciding where LLM integrations, agent workflows, and intelligent automation create real operational leverage.
•
Guide the team in building, deploying, and hardening AI-powered tools and features into production-grade systems.
•
Lead AI enablement for HR personnel directing training programs on tools like any AI so non-technical users can apply AI in their workflows.
•
Stay current with emerging HR technology, AI tooling, and platform trends; bring the outside in and translate it into actionable direction for the team.
Reporting, Analytics & Insight
•
Own executive-level People dashboards and reporting headcount, turnover, attrition, retention, OKR progress, performance distribution, flight risk, and workforce planning.
•
Ensure the team delivers actionable, decision-ready insight to leadership, not just data.
•
Direct the build of self-service analytics and reporting capabilities for HR and business users.
Team Leadership & Development
•
Lead, mentor, and develop a team - setting priorities, quality standards, and ways of working.
•
Build a high-performance culture where builders ship quality work, grow their skills, and take ownership.
•
Define and track team OKRs across delivery, data quality, platform reliability, automation coverage, and innovation.
•
Build capability, succession, and career paths within the function as scope and headcount scale.
•
Guide individual contributors through technical and professional growth coaching, code and architecture review, and structured feedback.
Stakeholder Management & Alignment
•
Partner with HR, IT, Data/Analytics, Finance, and business leaders to ensure People technology is aligned to organisational objectives.
•
Act as the single point of accountability for People technology delivery to the CPO and HR leadership.
•
Translate business requirements into clear technical direction for the team; translate technical constraints back to stakeholders without losing fidelity.
•
Drive adoption, training, and change management across the organisation for every system the team ships.
What You Bring
•
5+ years in HR technology, People systems, or a related engineering/platform leadership role, including at least 2 years directing a team.
•
Experience owning a People technology roadmap end to end — strategy, prioritisation, architecture decisions, and delivery accountability.
•
Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob, BambooHR, Workday, Workable etc.), ATS (Recruitee, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters), and performance management systems - not just as a user, but as someone who has configured, integrated, or built on them.
•
Technical fluency across the full stack: backend, frontend, APIs, databases, and DevOps. You can evaluate architecture, review technical trade-offs, and hold your team to a high bar even if you’re not writing production code daily.
•
Proven experience directing the build of custom platforms, internal tools, or AI-powered systems from concept to production.
•
Working knowledge of AI/LLM integrations, agentic automation, and applied AI in a business context.
•
Experience with OKR frameworks, performance management systems, or people analytics platforms ideally having directed the build or deep configuration of one.
•
Strong stakeholder management and communication across technical and non-technical audiences from engineering reviews to CPO-level strategy.
•
Working understanding of data privacy and security regulations across multiple jurisdictions.
Your X-Factor
•
You give direction, not just tasks. Your team knows why they’re building something, not just what.
•
You’re technically fluent enough to be dangerous. You don’t write every line, but you can challenge an architecture, spot a shortcut, and know when something is built well.
•
You think in platforms, not projects. Every system your team ships is part of a whole that will still make sense a year from now.
•
You bridge HR and engineering fluently, you understand what an HRBP needs and what a developer needs, and you translate between them without losing fidelity.
•
You own outcomes, not activity. You measure your function by what it delivers to the business, not by how busy it looks.
Your Journey After Applying
•
Stage 1: Screening call with the Talent Acquisition team.
•
Stage 2: Strategic discussion with the Chief People Officer vision for People Technology, leadership approach, and how you’d set direction for the function.
•
Stage 3: Final interview with the Chief People Officer and senior leadership.
•
Stage 4: Peer Session with the Team.
Why Join NEXT
At NEXT Ventures, people are our greatest advantage and our boldest investment. Here, HR isn’t a support function; it’s a growth engine. You’ll lead a People Technology function that builds the systems powering how a fast-scaling, multi-country fintech manages its most important asset: its people.
You won’t inherit a finished playbook. You’ll write it setting the vision, the architecture, and the culture for how People technology works at NEXT. If you want to own the direction, lead a team of builders, and see your decisions shape how 500+ people work across five countries, this is where you do it.
Your next big move starts here.

【正社員】PdM（開発・AI本部 事業統括部 ︎プロダクトマネジメントG）

仕事概要
**コインチェック株式会社について**
---
コインチェックは、2014年より暗号資産取引サービスを提供し、現在では国内トップクラスのダウンロード数を誇るプラットフォームへと成長してきました。2025年現在、暗号資産は「デジタルアセット」としての認識が進み、単なる投資対象から、価値交換・証券化・新たな経済圏の基盤へと変容しつつあります。

私たちはこの社会的な変化を、サービスとして実装するテック集団です。マネックスグループの一員として、高いコンプライアンス水準を守りながらも、新規サービスの立ち上げやブロックチェーン領域への挑戦など、スタートアップ的なスピードと柔軟さをあわせ持つ独自のポジションにあります。

インフラ、セキュリティ、バックエンドといったプロダクトの基盤は、すべて自社開発。数秒単位で価格が動く世界においても、安定かつスケーラブルな体験を提供することは、シンプルながら極めて高度なチャレンジです。こうした技術的課題を楽しめる方が、金融やEC、SaaSなどさまざまな業界からジョインし、活躍しています。

コインチェックが求めているのは、「クリプトに詳しい方」だけではありません。「今は詳しくないけれど、社会構造を変える技術に携わりたい」「未知のドメインに挑戦したい」といった熱量を持つ方を歓迎しています。

私たちと一緒に、次の経済基盤を創り出しませんか？

**募集背景**
---
組織変更に伴い新設された「開発・AI本部 事業統括部」は事業戦略に基づくプロダクト戦略の立案・実行、サービス運営に関する意思決定をする部門です。主にtoC向けのプロダクトは本部門で担当するため領域は広く、暗号資産やブロックチェーンといった最先端のテクノロジーと、 金融の堅実さが融合する環境において、AI時代を前提とした次世代のプロダクトマネジメントを推進できるリーダー候補を募集します。

**業務内容**
---
コインチェックが提供する新規・既存プロダクトのPM・PdMとして企画立案、要件定義、データ分析、ステークホルダーマネジメント、スクラムチームへの参加などへ広く関与頂きプロダクトを成功に導いて頂きます。単なる機能開発に留まらず、AIを活用した業務プロセスの再設計や、プロダクトへのAI実装をリードし、組織全体の生産性とプロダクト価値を最大化していただきます。

＜業務詳細＞
* ブロックチェーン等の高度な技術理解を活かした既存/新規プロダクトのグロース施策の立案と実行
* AIを前提とした、要件定義・ドキュメンテーションプロセスの再設計および標準化の推進
* 多様なステークホルダーとの調整及びマネジメント
* プロダクトマネージャーとしての技術方針推進、全体最適な視点での業務プロセスの改善提案

**本ポジションの魅力**
---
* 大規模ユーザーを抱えるサービスのプロダクトマネジメント
* DAU40万人におよぶ国内最大級の暗号資産交換所「Coincheck」のプロダクト開発をリードし、大規模ユーザーを抱えるサービスの成長を肌で感じることができます。
* IT×金融サービスでの経験
* 暗号資産業界は日進月歩で進化を続けています。セキュリティ、プライバシー保護、法規制対応など、最先端の技術に触れ、常に新しい知識を習得できます。
* 次世代プロダクト開発の最前線
* 業務そのものをAIで再設計し、国内最大級の暗号資産サービスをグロースさせる稀有な経験が積めます。
* 多様なステークホルダーとの協業
* エンジニア、デザイナー、法務、リスク管理など、様々な職種のメンバーと連携し、プロジェクトを推進します。これにより、幅広いビジネススキルを身につけることができます。
* 裁量ある仕事
* プロダクトの企画から開発、リリースまで、一連のプロセスに携わり、アイデアを形にすることができます。

**選考フロー**
---
**書類選考 → 1次面接 → 2次面接 → 最終面接**
※選考状況により、フローが一部変更となる場合がございます。

- ご希望やご状況に合わせて、選考ステップの短縮やスピード調整も可能です。
- 「まずは話を聞きたい」という方には、選考前にカジュアル面談を実施することも可能です。
- 最終面接前に、相互理解を深めるための人事面談（合否不問）をご案内する場合がございます。
- 2次面接は原則対面を予定しております。

**コールドウォレットGについて**
---
「新しい価値交換をもっと身近に」というミッションのもと、多くの方に簡単に暗号資産を保有していただけるよう、暗号資産を管理する手間を肩代わりするべく裏側のシステムを日々改善しているチームです。

コールドウォレットとはお客様の資産をオフラインで安全に保管するための暗号資産ウォレットを指しています。コールドウォレット Gでは、セキュリティのエキスパートのサポートも受けながらコールドウォレットのリスク低減や可用性向上、運用負荷低減に取り組んでいます。

幅広いレイヤーの技術に関われることが特徴で、コールドウォレット本体であるオフライン環境のアプリケーションとOSの開発や保守に加え、使用するハードウェアの選定から運用に使うWebアプリケーションのフロントエンドとバックエンドの開発まで関連部署と協力しながら業務を行なっています。

**コインチェック株式会社について**
---
コインチェックは、2014年より暗号資産取引サービスを提供し、現在では国内トップクラスのダウンロード数を誇るプラットフォームへと成長してきました。2025年現在、暗号資産は「デジタルアセット」としての認識が進み、単なる投資対象から、価値交換・証券化・新たな経済圏の基盤へと変容しつつあります。

私たちはこの社会的な変化を、サービスとして実装するテック集団です。マネックスグループの一員として、高いコンプライアンス水準を守りながらも、新規サービスの立ち上げやブロックチェーン領域への挑戦など、スタートアップ的なスピードと柔軟さをあわせ持つ独自のポジションにあります。

インフラ、セキュリティ、バックエンドといったプロダクトの基盤は、すべて自社開発。数秒単位で価格が動く世界においても、安定かつスケーラブルな体験を提供することは、シンプルながら極めて高度なチャレンジです。こうした技術的課題を楽しめる方が、金融やEC、SaaSなどさまざまな業界からジョインし、活躍しています。

コインチェックが求めているのは、「クリプトに詳しい方」だけではありません。「今は詳しくないけれど、社会構造を変える技術に携わりたい」「未知のドメインに挑戦したい」といった熱量を持つ方を歓迎しています。

**配属部署について**
---
配属先：内部監査室
業務執行部門（1線）や間接管理部門（2線）から独立した立場（3線）で、会社の事業活動に対して評価を実施して保証を与える部門です。

**業務内容**
----
**内部監査の計画・実施・報告**
* 年間監査計画の策定、特に金商法に基づく分別管理、最良執行方針、広告規制、情報管理等の金融特有の管理体制に焦点を当てた個別監査テーマの設定。
* 金融業務監査の実施: 顧客資産管理、取引監視、コールドウォレット/ホットウォレット管理、システムリスク管理等、高い専門性が求められる領域の内部統制の有効性評価を行います。
* 監査結果に基づく厳格な改善指摘と、改善施策の提言。
* 監査報告書の作成と経営層および監査役会への報告。

**規制対応とモニタリング**
* 金商法、資金決済法、犯収法等の法規制改正動向の把握と、社内体制への影響評価。
* 専門的レビュー: IT統制、サイバーセキュリティ対策、AML/CFT（反社会的勢力・マネーロンダリング対策）体制に関する専門的監査レビューへの関与。

**担当する業務の魅力**
---
* 取締役会直轄の部門であり、監査結果は取締役会への報告となることから、会社経営に密接に関わる立場で仕事ができること
* 金融機関としての各種レギュレーションを遵守しつつ、業界の環境変化に柔軟に対応する必要があることから、リスクに対して真摯に向き合った監査が実施できること
* 新規サービスの提供や、内部統制の高度化を進めていることから、新しく監査対象となる業務に対して監査手続をゼロベースで構築するケースも相応にあり、多様な経験を積むことができること
* DX化が進む社会環境において、いち早くデジタルベースであるFintech企業で監査人としての経験を積むことができること

* 金融・法律・IT・会計・マーケティングなど、各領域の専門家と働き、複数の領域にまたがる問題解決に携わる機会
* 上述した領域横断的な問題について、データを活用して適切な意思決定を行うための業務に携わる機会
* 自社のwebアプリケーションを開発する日本のIT企業の中で客観的に比較しても、非常に大規模なデータベースを管理している企業の業務に携わり、多数の観点のバランスを取りながら業務を遂行する機会
* 最先端の技術領域であるブロックチェーン技術について、常に情報が入ってくる環境でその分野の理解度を高めながら、自身のコミットメント次第で多分野にわたる難易度の高い問題解決を任される機会
* 様々なバックグラウンドのコインチェックで働く仲間から、論理的思考力、ドキュメンテーション能力、批判的思考力、メタ認知能力など、基礎的なビジネスパーソンとして必要とされるスキルセットについてフィードバックを受け、能力を高める機会

上述した様々な要素のうち、一部を経験できる企業はたしかに他に存在しますが、これら全てを一度に経験できるエキサイティングな機会、そしてその中でもコインチェックの規模でビジネス展開をしている企業は、日本で他にはほとんど存在しないと言っても過言ではありません。

**コインチェック株式会社について**
---
コインチェックは、2014年より暗号資産取引サービスを提供し、現在では国内トップクラスのダウンロード数を誇るプラットフォームへと成長してきました。2025年現在、暗号資産は「デジタルアセット」としての認識が進み、単なる投資対象から、価値交換・証券化・新たな経済圏の基盤へと変容しつつあります。

私たちはこの社会的な変化を、サービスとして実装するテック集団です。マネックスグループの一員として、高いコンプライアンス水準を守りながらも、新規サービスの立ち上げやブロックチェーン領域への挑戦など、スタートアップ的なスピードと柔軟さをあわせ持つ独自のポジションにあります。

インフラ、セキュリティ、バックエンドといったプロダクトの基盤は、すべて自社開発。数秒単位で価格が動く世界においても、安定かつスケーラブルな体験を提供することは、シンプルながら極めて高度なチャレンジです。こうした技術的課題を楽しめる方が、金融やEC、SaaSなどさまざまな業界からジョインし、活躍しています。

コインチェックが求めているのは、「クリプトに詳しい方」だけではありません。「今は詳しくないけれど、社会構造を変える技術に携わりたい」「未知のドメインに挑戦したい」といった熱量を持つ方を歓迎しています。

Work with Product and Engineering on acceptance criteria and shift-left testing from the requirement stage.

Evaluate and introduce QA tools that improve speed, coverage and reliability.

7+ years in software quality assurance, including 2+ years leading a QA team.

Under your leadership, your team will seamlessly integrate Privacy by Design principles into our products, execute day-to-day data subject requests (DSARs), and implement automated, continuous audit readiness for IT governance (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001). As a Senior Product Manager, Internal Products, you will own and evolve our internal products, starting with the core ERP platform used across Business Development, Customer Support, Accounting, and Back Office teams. This is a product ownership role focused on discovery, prioritization, and improving how internal teams work. You will work closely with Operations and Business Development to understand their workflows, pain points, and requests, determine which problems are worth solving, and turn them into a clear product roadmap. You will also represent internal users when new customer-facing products and features are being designed, ensuring internal teams have the right tools, information, and workflows to support customers effectively once those features go live.

The role starts with bringing structure and transparency to the existing backlog and gradually evolves toward proactive discovery, process optimization, automation, and long-term improvement of our internal platforms.

Responsibilities

• Own product discovery and prioritization for the internal ERP platform

• Build and maintain the product roadmap for internal tools

• Collect, structure, and evaluate requests coming from Operations, Business Development, Customer Support, Back Office, Accounting, and other internal stakeholders

• Identify the actual problem behind stakeholder requests instead of treating requested solutions as requirements

• Independently prioritize initiatives based on business impact, user pain, operational efficiency, and implementation complexity

• Make product decisions and confidently challenge or reject requests when another solution would create more value

• Work directly with internal users through interviews, workflow analysis, observation, and discovery sessions

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational and business processes

• Participate in discussions around new customer-facing features and define what internal capabilities are required to support them successfully

• Ensure Customer Support and Operations teams have the necessary data, workflows, tools, and controls when new products or features are launched

• Partner with the Delivery team throughout implementation while maintaining ownership of the problem, product requirements, and expected outcome

Key Product Challenges

In the first stage, you will focus on:

• Creating visibility into existing requests and pain points across Operations and Business Development

• Establishing a clear and transparent prioritization process

• Creating a roadmap for improving the current ERP experience

• Identifying the most painful and repetitive workflows

• Automating high-impact manual processes

As the product matures, the role will increasingly focus on proactive discovery, product analytics, process optimization, and identifying opportunities before they become explicit stakeholder requests.

Success in This Role

• We have a clear understanding of the key pain points experienced by Operations and Business Development teams

• We have a prioritized product roadmap focused on addressing the most important problems within our internal systems

• The most repetitive and time-consuming operational workflows are increasingly automated

• Requests from internal stakeholders are evaluated consistently rather than being delivered on a first-come, first-served basis

• Internal teams are properly equipped to support customers whenever new customer-facing functionality is launched

• Product decisions are increasingly supported by usage and operational data

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Product Management, including experience owning product priorities and making independent product decisions

• Strong experience working with internal products, enterprise systems, CRM, ERP, back-office platforms, operational tooling, or similar products

• Strong product discovery skills and ability to identify underlying user problems rather than simply collect feature requests

• Proven ability to manage and prioritize a complex backlog across multiple stakeholder groups

• Experience building product roadmaps and translating business problems into product initiatives

• Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to work with teams that have different and sometimes conflicting priorities

• Experience working closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Business Development, or other operational functions

• Ability to challenge stakeholder requests constructively and make trade-offs based on expected value

• Strong analytical mindset and willingness to use data to evaluate product problems and outcomes

• Experience working effectively with engineering and delivery teams without needing to manage technical implementation directly

• Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment

This is a to-C product serving hundreds of millions of users, directly impacting account security and identity verification experience at scale.

Our work sits where three forces meet: enormous scale, strict security and regulatory constraints, and the reality that one extra verification step can block an attacker or lock out a legitimate user. We ship across web, mobile mini programs, and in-app webviews, and we publish the shared authentication libraries and SDKs that the rest of Binance builds on.

• Build and refine the BFF layer — aggregating upstream security services and turning raw error codes into results the frontend can consume and users can act on

• Use funnel and event data to find drop-off in login and verification flows, and drive optimization from evidence rather than intuition

About the role
We are seeking a senior, market-aware Liquidity Analyst to own day-to-day liquidity performance and execution quality across FX and CFDs. The role combines real-time market judgement, LP management, bridge configuration and data-led improvement. You will work independently in live markets, engage directly with liquidity providers, and partner with internal stakeholders to improve pricing, depth and execution outcomes.

Responsibility
Liquidity and execution management
• Monitor market conditions, including volatility, spreads, depth, session transitions and event risk. Identify deterioration in pricing or execution quality and take timely corrective action.
• Own and optimise bridge configurations, including routing, filters, failover logic, throttles, symbol and session settings, and mark-ups.
• Maintain effective primary and backup liquidity arrangements, including appropriate controls for fast or abnormal market conditions.

LP performance ownership
• Assess LP performance across spread competitiveness, depth, quote stability, response times, reject rates, slippage, execution consistency and last-look behaviour.
• Maintain LP scorecards and lead performance reviews to support liquidity selection, coverage and routing decisions.
• Engage directly with LPs to investigate issues and improve pricing, depth and execution outcomes.

Incident management and controls
• Investigate pricing and trade incidents using bridge logs, market data and trade records; determine root cause, coordinate resolution and implement preventative controls.
• Exercise sound judgement during fast markets, including when to switch or restrict liquidity.
• Maintain clear documentation of configurations, incident findings and operating procedures to support scalable, repeatable operations.

Analytics and continuous improvement
• Build and maintain scalable pre- and post-trade analytics and monitoring covering liquidity quality, slippage, rejects, pricing quality and execution consistency.
• Translate findings into practical configuration or LP-management changes, and validate their impact through before-and-after analysis.

Requirements
• 5 or more years' experience in liquidity management, electronic execution, market operations or a related markets-facing role within FX and CFDs.
• Strong understanding of market microstructure and execution metrics, including slippage, rejects, quote stability and last-look impact.
• Hands-on experience with oneZero or comparable bridge and liquidity-management technology.
• Demonstrated experience assessing LP performance and managing primary and backup liquidity arrangements.
• Advanced SQL and Python skills, with hands-on experience analysing high-volume tick, pricing and trade data. Able to build reliable diagnostics, reporting and monitoring that translate analysis into practical liquidity and execution improvements.
• Able to investigate complex execution issues independently and communicate clearly with LPs and internal stakeholders.

• Collaborative and inclusive work environment with exposure to cross-region operations.
• Health and wellness benefits.
• Flexible working arrangements.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Bitvavo, we believe that exceptional employee experiences fuel high performing teams and bold company growth. As a People Operations Specialist, you will be the day to day engine behind the employee lifecycle across our pan European, multi entity setup, supporting everything from onboarding to offboarding, and keeping our core HR processes running accurately and smoothly.

You will bring structure and reliability to high volume operational work, while building deep expertise across our European entities. This is a strong next step for someone who has moved past the basics of HR administration and is ready to take real ownership of processes, with support close at hand as you grow.


LOCATION

This role is based in Amsterdam. Relocation is not available for this position, and we are only considering candidates who are currently residing in the Netherlands.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Act as the first point of contact for employee inquiries, managing and resolving requests through our ticketing system within defined SLAs, and support benefits administration and documentation updates

 - Provide day to day support across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, benefits, visas, leaves and data changes, across our multi entity setup

 - Maintain data accuracy and contribute to monthly reporting

 - Escalate non standard, high risk or complex issues to the Team Lead with clear context

 - Build growing knowledge of People Ops processes, compliance requirements across our entities, and HRIS capabilities

 - Collaborate closely with People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, managers and other business stakeholders to provide high quality operational support


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

This role requires at least 3 years of experience in a People Operations or HR Generalist role, including a mandatory minimum of 2 years of experience in the Dutch market with Dutch labour law. We are not able to consider candidates without this experience.

You are reliable, detail oriented, and genuinely care about getting things right for the people you support. You are comfortable owning recurring processes end to end, but you also know when something is outside the standard playbook, and loop in your Team Lead with the context they need to make fast decisions.

 - Ideally gained in a fast paced, tech or scale-up environment

 - Comfortable managing administrative processes across multiple entities

 - Strong prioritization and attention to detail, able to handle multiple open threads at once without losing accuracy

 - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills


DESIRABLE

About Busha

Since our inception in 2018, Busha has been at the forefront of digital currency exchange, offering trading options in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum. Our mission is to build an open financial system characterized by innovation, efficiency, and user-friendliness. We value Clear Communication, Positive Energy, Efficient Execution, and Continuous Learning in all our team members.

At Busha, we are building technology that makes financial services more accessible, efficient and reliable. Busha Pro is our spot exchange for crypto and fiat, where speed, reliability and security are essential to delivering a seamless trading experience for our users.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to work on the engineering behind a live exchange where speed, reliability and accuracy matter.

You will take ownership of and improve the systems responsible for processing orders, matching trades and supporting exchange operations: operating them in production, making them faster and extending them safely.

Overview

We are looking for someone who understands more than just writing code. You should understand how trading systems work, how to build them reliably at scale and how to solve the technical challenges that come with real-time transactions.

You will have meaningful ownership of technical decisions, shape the platform's architecture and work closely with the wider team to turn product requirements into reliable, production-ready systems.

Responsibilities

• Take ownership of the Busha Pro exchange: learn the codebase deeply, operate it in production and harden it.
• Design, build and optimize the backend systems that power Busha Pro’s trading capabilities.
• Develop and improve matching engine components, order books, order processing and trade execution workflows. Keep matching deterministic and consistent under peak load, with no crossed books, ghost fills or stale order state.
• Build reliable systems that can handle high transaction volumes while maintaining speed, accuracy and consistency.
• Work on APIs (REST, WebSocket, and later FIX), real-time market data, event-driven services and integrations that connect different parts of the trading platform.
• Improve system performance, reduce latency and identify bottlenecks before they become production issues. Benchmark and profile the matching path, load-test against realistic traffic and measure every change against a baseline.
• Build safeguards that help maintain accurate order processing, transaction integrity and reliable system recovery: pre-trade risk checks, price bands, circuit breakers, kill switches, failover and disaster recovery.
• Keep the ledger exact: trades and fees settled atomically, real-time balances, and crypto and fiat deposits and withdrawals reconciled against custody and banking records.
• Add trading pairs, order types (such as OCO, take-profit and stop-loss) and features, released with zero downtime.
• Analyze business product requirements and propose effective technical solutions.
• Write clean, testable and maintainable code, and participate in code reviews and technical design discussions. Test matching and ledger invariants with simulation and replay.
• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through testing, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
• Share the on-call rotation for production trading systems.
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering and DevOps to deliver key technical priorities.
• Share your knowledge, support other engineers and contribute to strong engineering practices.

What We're Looking For

• 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development experience.
• Strong in Go, or strong in Rust, C++ or Java and willing to work primarily in Go.

• Hands-on experience building, operating or improving trading systems, exchange infrastructure, matching engines or comparable real-time transaction-processing platforms.
• A solid understanding of order books, order lifecycles, matching logic and trade execution.
• Experience building systems where performance, concurrency, reliability and data consistency are critical, including idempotency, exactly-once processing and recovery from partial failures.
• Experience working on systems that require low latency, high availability and predictable execution under heavy load.
• Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, databases and distributed systems.
• Experience designing APIs, event-driven services and scalable backend architectures.
• Good judgment in an existing codebase: you improve a live system in small, safe steps rather than reaching for a rewrite.
• Performance work grounded in measurement: profiling, latency percentiles (p99 and above), and memory and garbage-collection tuning.
• Working knowledge of Linux internals (threading, CPU and NUMA effects, system calls) and TCP/UDP networking.
• A practical approach to testing, debugging, performance optimisation and production reliability, including testing that proves correctness through simulation, fuzzing or replaying production traffic.
• You've run what you built in production, including on-call and incident response, and can debug across the OS, network and application layers.
• The ability to take ownership of complex technical work and deliver it with minimal supervision.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly.

Requirements

• Experience at a cryptocurrency exchange, financial trading platform or electronic market.
• Familiarity with risk controls, settlement or market data infrastructure.
• Crypto infrastructure: wallets, custody, blockchain nodes, deposit and withdrawal pipelines.
• Fiat payment rails: bank transfers, local payment networks, settlement and reconciliation.
• The FIX protocol, event sourcing, or low-latency patterns such as the LMAX Disruptor.
• Experience with market surveillance, regulatory reporting or audits at a regulated venue.
• TypeScript/Node.js for services, gateways or internal tools around the engine.

What Success Looks Like

You'll help us build trading systems that are reliable, performant and ready to scale. You'll take ownership of important engineering deliverables, improve the quality of our infrastructure and help ensure that orders and trades are processed accurately and efficiently.

We value engineers who are proactive, thoughtful in their technical decisions and comfortable taking responsibility for the systems they build.

Why Join Busha?

At Busha, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging financial technology, influence important engineering decisions and help shape the infrastructure behind Busha Pro.

If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, building performance-sensitive systems and working on technology where reliability and precision genuinely matter, we'd love to hear from you.

The platform moves real value, so security is not a feature bolted on at the end. It is a property of everything the team ships. This is a hybrid engineering and security seat built for someone who is genuinely both: you ship products alongside the engineering team when the security queue is quiet, and you own security work end to end when it lands. You report into engineering and partner closely with the Payward security, CISO, and compliance functions.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own security deliverables end to end. Coordinate and review smart-contract audits, respond to security questionnaires and due-diligence requests, support CISO and compliance initiatives, and turn findings into tracked, closed-out fixes.

 - Run offensive assessments against our own platforms. Pentest the web apps, APIs, backend services, and on-chain components, and build the tooling to do it repeatedly rather than once.

 - Continuously assess posture. Threat-model new and existing systems, review architecture and key-management flows, and maintain a living view of the risks and their mitigations.

 - Review code for security. Be a default reviewer on changes touching auth, cryptography, custody, signing, and fund movement across our chains.

 - Harden the platform. Improve secrets handling, IAM and least-privilege, dependency and supply-chain hygiene, and detection and logging for security-relevant events.

 - Secure custody and signing workflows. Review and harden transaction signing flows, MPC and HSM integrations, signer permissions, admin roles, approval policies, and break-glass procedures.

 - Contribute to product engineering. Pick up regular backlog work in TypeScript so you stay close to the codebase you are defending.

 - Support incidents. Help with detection, triage, response, and post-mortems, and feed the lessons back into the program.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - An engineer first. You write and review production code comfortably, TypeScript and Node.js in our stack, and you understand systems deeply enough to break them.

 - Strong application and infrastructure security fundamentals. The OWASP-class vulnerability landscape, authn and authz, injection, SSRF, supply-chain risk, and secure design. You have done real offensive work in pentesting, vuln research, or red-team.

 - Applied cryptography and blockchain security. Symmetric and asymmetric primitives, hashing, signatures, and key management, plus the security model of EVM, Solana, and ideally TON or Tron. You can read a smart contract and reason about how it fails.

 - Ownership. You can take an ambiguous security item, an audit, a questionnaire, or an incident, and drive it to closure without being managed through it.

 - Clear communication. You can explain a risk to engineers, to a CISO, and to an auditor, and tailor the message to each.

 - An automation instinct. You do not want to catch the same issue manually twice, so you turn findings into tests, alerts, controls, documentation, or platform improvements.

 - Risk judgment. You can tell a theoretical issue from a material one, and communicate severity, likelihood, impact, and remediation tradeoffs clearly.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience commissioning or remediating third-party smart-contract audits.

 - Familiarity with custody and signing infrastructure such as HSMs, MPC, and ForDefi-style providers, and with on-chain transaction security.

 - Cloud security depth in GCP or AWS, IAM, and container and runtime hardening.

 - Detection engineering and security observability, including SIEM and log-based detections.

 - Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or GWAPT.

 - Prior work in a regulated fintech or tokenization/DeFi environment.

About the Job

We are looking for a Salesforce QA Engineer who approaches quality with an engineering mindset. At IC, Salesforce is where our sales, retention, partner and support teams work every day, and much of what they see is fetched live from other systems and varies by role, region and regulated entity. You will test custom Lightning Web Components, the automations behind them and the integrations with other systems, planning the edge cases, querying the data and proving what is really happening. If you enjoy writing SOQL to validate complex data, testing APIs with Postman and owning the quality of a feature from refinement to release, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll own

• Collaborate closely with other product streams and technical teams, understand the end-to-end business process, looking beyond the immediate Salesforce implementation to grasp where data originates, how it transforms, and its downstream impact.

• Test features end to end across LWC screens and business logic, from lead conversion and assignment to client lifecycle and partner changes.

• Validate complex CRM processes including client onboarding, automated account assignment, and multi-region regulatory compliance rules.

• Validate end-to-end financial workflows: KYC/verification document pipelines, trading account lifecycle management, and deposit/withdrawal processing.

• Verify bi-directional API data exchange between Salesforce, proprietary services, third-party trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and payment gateways.

• Test inbound and outbound REST integrations with Postman, covering payloads, status codes, negative cases, simulated errors and integration logs.

• Verify the Salesforce security model by running scenarios as each persona, such as relationship managers, BDMs, partner agents and support staff.

• Design and maintain test plans, test cases and regression suites in Jira and Qmetry.

• Investigate root causes, log high-quality defect reports with detailed reproduction steps, and partner closely with developers through resolution.

• Add acceptance criteria and edge cases in refinement, and run regression in stage and UAT before each release.

• Build and maintain automated UI regression for key user journeys with Playwright.

• Review and refine AI-generated test cases and Playwright scripts against acceptance criteria and designs.

• Propose improvements to our test process, tooling and release checks.

• Own test strategy and release quality as the only QA engineer in your product stream, working alongside the wider Salesforce QA team.

What you’ll need

Essential

• 3+ years of hands-on software testing in the Salesforce ecosystem.

• A solid grasp of standard and custom objects, relationships, Person Accounts, record types, automation and platform limits.

• Thorough understanding of the Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets and groups, custom permissions, roles, sharing rules and FLS.

• SOQL for data validation using Developer Console or the sf CLI.

• API testing with Postman: REST, JSON, authentication, HTTP status codes and error paths.

• Jira and a test management tool such as QMetry, Xray or Zephyr.

• Test design techniques: boundary values, equivalence classes, state transitions and role-based matrices.

• Hands-on UI test automation with Playwright or an equivalent framework, such as Selenium or Cypress.

• Proven ability to onboard rapidly, take full ownership of feature quality, work independently, and make proactive decisions in a fast-paced environment.

• Data generation and manipulation using tools like Data Loader, Salesforce Inspector, or Workbench.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.






THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders live. Millions of them. But a great product only wins if the right traders find it, trust it, and actually fund an account. Right now, our organic engine isn’t pulling its weight.

You’re going to fix that.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re seeking a hands-on Head of Organic Growth to own how Kraken Pro gets discovered and how curious traders become active ones. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the traders we serve is essential. Organic is where brand and acquisition meet.

We’re looking for a player-coach who moves fast but thinks long-term, gets in the weeds while leading from the front, and knows that traffic means nothing if it doesn’t convert. This role demands sharp B2C acquisition instincts, a product-first mindset, an obsession with UX, and a self-starter attitude.

 - Own organic acquisition. Build and run the strategy across SEO, content, social, community, referrals, and partnerships to bring high-intent traders to Kraken Pro.

 - Find out if people convert. Map the funnel from first touch to first trade, report on it clearly, and figure out where traders drop off and how to win them back.

 - Make UX your edge. Work with Product and Design to audit and improve landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding, and in-product moments. Great acquisition dies in bad UX, and you know it.

 - Acquire through brand. Make every growth channel a brand-building one. Reach is easy to buy; trust is what makes traders stay.

 - Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.

 - Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.

 - Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.

 - Report what matters. Build clear dashboards and insights that show leadership what’s driving growth, what isn’t, and what to do next.

 - Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years in B2C acquisition or growth marketing, ideally in fintech, crypto, trading or gaming with experience in a player-coach role leading a small team.

 - Product savvy. You understand how products work, why people use them, and how to turn features into growth.

 - UX instinct. You can spot friction in a flow from a mile away and brief Product and Design on how to fix it.

 - High AI competency. Enabling you to multiply your impact and keep up with demand.

 - Analytical rigor. Comfortable with funnels, cohorts, attribution, and experimentation, and able to turn data into decisions and clear stories.

 - Speed under pressure. Markets don’t wait for approval cycles and neither do you.

 - Range as a marketer. SEO, content, social, lifecycle, partnerships. You know enough about each to direct the work, and you can roll up your sleeves when needed.

 - Taste. Knowing which channels and tactics not to pursue is as valuable as knowing which to scale.

 - Familiarity trading culture, and the language traders use.

 - Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared growth goal.



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/

Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly.

This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive ("MiFID II"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation ("MiCA"), the Payment Services Directive ("PSD2"), the Electronic Money Directive ("EMD2") and banking rules at the same time. You will bring clarity on which regime applies, what it requires, and how to launch within it.

 




THE OPPORTUNITY

Reporting to the Head of Product Legal, you will  act as a senior legal adviser to European leadership on new products, licensing structure and regulatory strategy.

 - Own cross-functional product counselling for European Union launches from discovery to design, launch and iteration, giving Product, Engineering, Compliance and leadership decision-ready advice with clear options and risk trade-offs

 - Advise on the regulatory perimeter and classification of new offerings across MiFID II and the Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation ("MiFIR"), MiCA, the European Market Infrastructure Regulation ("EMIR"), payment services and electronic money rules, and banking regulation, including where an instrument or service falls between regimes (for example tokenised securities, crypto-asset derivatives, margin and financing, and stablecoin-linked products)

 - Advise on payments and electronic money offerings, including the Krak card and account propositions, safeguarding, open banking and account-access obligations, and the developing Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation framework

 - Advise on banking-related questions that arise in the European Union, including bank partnerships and sponsor-bank arrangements, deposit-taking and lending perimeter questions, the Capital Requirements Regulation and Directive, and the interaction of these rules with our custody, prime brokerage and financing products

 - Monitor and interpret European Union legislative and supervisory developments, take part in consultations and industry association work where appropriate, and translate their significance for the business proactively

 - Draft and negotiate client-facing terms and conditions, taking clear, business-aligned positions

 - Act as gatekeeper for European Union outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate and manage cost, and sign off before matters go externally

 - Mentor and develop more junior lawyers in the team, set quality standards for plain-English, risk-based advice, and act as a senior sounding board for colleagues across the Regulatory Legal team

 - Use AI-assisted tools (for example Enterprise GPTs) to speed up regulatory analysis, first drafts and matter tracking, and to build self-service tools that let stakeholders answer commoditised legal and regulatory questions themselves

 - Advise on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements affecting products, including the Transfer of Funds Regulation ("Travel Rule") and the new European Union anti-money laundering package, and on market abuse, conduct, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act ("DORA")

 - Lead or oversee licensing, authorisation and variation workstreams in the European Union, including scoping requirements, mapping pathways, supervising outside counsel, preparing application materials and managing regulator interactions

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Qualified lawyer admitted in Ireland, England and Wales, or another European Union Member State

 - 15 or more years' post-qualification experience ("PQE") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, central counterparty or crypto services provider) or at a leading law firm supporting such clients, ideally with in-house or direct product counselling experience

 - Deep, current knowledge of several of the following, with real depth in at least two: MiFID II and MiFIR (investment services, market structure, derivatives and conduct), MiCA (crypto-asset services, custody, trading platforms and stablecoins), European Union payment services and electronic money regulation, and European Union banking regulation

 - Demonstrated ability to analyse novel products against overlapping regimes and give a clear view on classification and perimeter, including in areas where the rules are unsettled or supervisors have not yet spoken

 - Direct experience managing senior regulator relationships, including notifications, information requests, supervisory correspondence and examinations

 - Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including DORA

 - Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions

 - Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing

 - Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders and for senior leadership

 - A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation

 - Experience mentoring or managing lawyers, and the judgement to know when to escalate

 - Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving, remote environment

 - Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase the efficiency of legal services

 
 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience advising on tokenised securities and the European Union Distributed Ledger Technology Pilot Regime

 - Experience with EMIR, including the clearing obligation, margin for non-centrally cleared derivatives and transaction reporting

 - Experience with prime brokerage, securities financing, margin lending or institutional custody

Job Description
As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, the Client Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a 1.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.
In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI’s strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward-looking operating model, driving a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client-centric and data-driven approach.
The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank’s integrity-related client lifecycle framework.

Key responsibilities:
1. Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Management
• Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.
• Establish and maintain a strong, risk-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI’s remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank’s risk tolerance.
• Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision-making.
• Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.
• Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI’s area of responsibility.
• Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.
• Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.
• Build and develop a high-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.
• Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews.
2. Client Onboarding, Integrity-related Lifecycle Management & AML Transaction Monitoring
• Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank’s risk tolerance.
• Oversee integrity-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
• Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.
• Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department.
3. Process Effectiveness, Automation & Continuous Improvement
• Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.
• Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.
• Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.
• Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

Qualifications
• 10+ years of professional experience in a leadership position in Operations, Compliance, AML, Risk Management or similar functions within a banking, financial services or fintech environment.
• Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Law, Business Administration or equivalent degree.
• Proven track record in process optimisation, automation, digitalisation and operational excellence.
• A relevant certification in project management, process improvement or transformation (e.g. PMP) is considered an asset.
• Strong understanding of how data, technology, workflow tools and AI can be used to enhance control effectiveness, decision-making and operational efficiency.
• Strong expertise in client onboarding, KYC/AML, client lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring, with a broad understanding of related legal and regulatory requirements.
• Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities, particularly when dealing with complex or high-impact regulatory and operational matters.
• Demonstrated experience managing and developing large and diverse teams, with a strong track record of building high-performing management structures, developing talent and leadership capabilities, and establishing effective career development and succession planning frameworks.
• Past exposure to Executive Management, regulators, auditors and senior internal stakeholders.
• High level of integrity, sound judgement and professional credibility, combined with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative leadership approach.
• Native French or English speaker, with full professional fluency in the other language.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role that owns the whole fraud control loop: investigate, analyze, set up rules, monitor, and improve. You will work tickets daily, turn what you find into data-backed fraud rules and strategies, monitor how they perform, and keep refining them. Each stage feeds the next.

You will own the card risk control strategy, from set-up through ongoing performance, and be accountable for the fraud rate and the interception rate.

Key Responsibilities

1. Investigation

•

Handle card risk tickets daily: review rule-triggered alerts, investigate suspicious accounts and transactions, and decide on block, decline, step-up, or card-lifecycle actions within SLA

•

Investigate fraud typologies: account takeover, card testing, BIN attacks, merchant collusion, friendly fraud, and first-party abuse

•

Assess merchant and transaction risk by MCC risk type, including high-risk merchants and non-card payment flows

•

Manage disputes and chargebacks end to end under Visa/Mastercard rules: evidence, representation, pre-arbitration, and arbitration

2. Data Analysis

•

Turn investigation findings into patterns: analyze ticket, alert, and transaction data to identify fraud trends, attack vectors, and coverage gaps

•

Measure false positives against loss to judge whether existing rules are effective

3. Rule Set-up

•

Design and set up fraud rules, velocity limits, and strategies based on the analysis

•

Make sure rule triggers and decisions stay compliant; escalate linked AML/sanctions concerns to Compliance

4. Rule Monitoring

•

Continuously monitor alert and ticket data after rules go live

•

Track and report KPIs: fraud loss rate (bps), chargeback ratio, approval rate, alert handling time, recovery rate

•

Keep the programme within scheme monitoring thresholds (e.g. VAMP, ECM/EFM) and support scheme and partner audits

5. Rule Improvement

•

Adjust, retire, and add rules in response to monitoring results, balancing fraud loss against false positives and approval rate

•

Feed fraud trends back to Product and Engineering to improve onboarding, 3DS, and authorisation controls

Requirements

•

3+ years in card fraud strategy or payments risk at an issuer, EMI, neobank, PSP, or card programme manager

•

Proven hands-on experience building and tuning fraud rules and strategies, not only working tickets

•

Hands-on knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard dispute rules, reason codes, and chargeback timelines

•

Experience with MCC-based risk, high-risk merchants, and non-card payments

•

Strong data skills: SQL and Excel/Sheets to pull, slice, and explain fraud trends

•

Fluent English; Mandarin or other European languages are a plus

Nice to Have

•

Crypto-linked or prepaid/debit card programme experience, including crypto-to-fiat conversion at authorisation

•

Card risk control experience across multiple countries/regions

•

Experience launching a card programme in a new market or with a new BIN sponsor

•

Scheme monitoring programme remediation experience

•

Python or BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, Metabase)

•

Certifications: CFE, ACAMS, or equivalent
